description.fun: Swinub snuffles through mud and snow with its pig-like nose for anything to eat, its favourite being a mushroom that grows under dead grass, and now and then it stumbles on a hot spring. People in ancient Hisui relied on it for that knack. Its fur is so shaggy that its legs barely show, and its eyes always look shut.
description.guide: A small Ice- and Ground-type pig Pokémon covered in thick, striped fur. It digs through mud and snow with its nose looking for food. It evolves into Piloswine at level 33, and then into Mamoswine.
description.tagline: A shaggy piglet that snuffles up mushrooms and hot springs

description.fun: Piloswine's shaggy fur usually covers its eyes, so it gets around by its nose, and as a result it's constantly charging at foes; the hairs on its back standing up are the warning. Its ice tusks thicken when it snows. It was designed by Shigeki Morimoto, who wanted Pokémon to cover all twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac, the boar included.
description.guide: A large Ice- and Ground-type boar Pokémon with ice tusks and fur that covers its eyes and legs. It relies on its nose and digs for food under snow. It evolves from Swinub, and into Mamoswine when levelled up knowing Ancient Power.
description.tagline: A hairy boar that can't see where it's charging

description.fun: Mamoswine roamed the whole world in the last ice age, and its numbers fell as the climate warmed. It can survive cold and hunger almost indefinitely: one frozen for ten thousand years has been revived. Fittingly, Piloswine has to know Ancient Power to evolve into it, and in Kalos people ride rental Mamoswine through the snow of Route 17, the Mamoswine Road.
description.guide: A large Ice- and Ground-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, resembling a woolly mammoth crossed with a boar, with tusks of solid ice. It evolves from Piloswine levelled up knowing Ancient Power and is the final form of Swinub.
description.tagline: An ice-age mammoth-boar that once roamed the whole world
